style: Semi-realistic hand-painted visual novel, matching existing Serbian Summer art. TV-safe summer clothes only: knee-length board shorts, athletic tanks and shorts, a red lifeguard uniform. No nudity, no lingerie, no groin focus, no sexual poses, no readable text or logos.

assets.prompt: Ada Ciganlija lake beach in Belgrade: pebbles, bicycles, wide water, a distant bridge and fortress, sunset, no large people.
Tree-lined promenade beside the Sava lake, benches, a cafe umbrella, summer afternoon, no readable signs.
Wooden lifeguard tower on a pebble shore. Adult woman lifeguard in a red athletic tank, red shorts, whistle and rescue buoy, standing calmly. Full head in frame.
Shirtless adult lifeguard with a natural athletic torso, loose red knee-length board shorts and a whistle, on wooden tower steps by a lake bridge. No bulge, no flexing pose.
Beach cafe table, umbrella and a cooler of cut watermelon beside the lake. No people, no text.
